LanguageData.FB_FleshDrainArrivedText: A crew from {0} has walked onto the map: {1} of them, with {2} siphon pumps to drive into the flesh cover. Together the pumps will pull about {3} hemogel an hour straight out of the colony's reserve, and canister it where they stand.\n\nThey have not come to fight. Their guards will hold the camp and nothing more - as long as a single pump still stands.
LanguageData.FB_FleshDrainPumpsLostMessage: The crew from {0} has lost its pumps and is turning on the colony.
LanguageData.FB_FleshDrainQuotaMessage: The crew from {0} has taken what it came for and is leaving.
LanguageData.FB_FleshDrainDryMessage: The reserve is dry and there is nothing left to pump. The crew from {0} is packing up.
LanguageData.FB_FleshDrainLowMessage: The colony's reserve is down to a fifth - there is no longer enough worth taking. The crew from {0} is packing up.
LanguageData.FB_HemogelCanisterPourDesc: Empty this stack into the colony hemogel network: {0} hemogel. The canister must lie on flesh cover. Note that hemogel back in the network can be siphoned again, while a canister in storage cannot.
LanguageData.FB_HemogelCanisterPoured: Poured {0} hemogel back into the network.
LanguageData.FB_HemogelCanisterPourNotOnFlesh: The canister must lie on flesh cover.
LanguageData.FB_HemogelCanisterPourNetworkFull: The colony hemogel network has no room for this canister.
LanguageData.FB_HemogelCanisterPouredPartial: Poured {0} hemogel back into the network. It cannot hold more; canisters left: {1}.
LanguageData.FB_FleshDrainPumpNoPower: No power: the pump is idle.
LanguageData.FB_FleshDrainPumpNoFlesh: Not on flesh cover: nothing to draw from.
LanguageData.FB_NeuronSuppressorInspect: Tendrils suppressed within {0} cells: no grabbing, no hauling.
LanguageData.FB_NeuronSuppressorNoPower: No power: the field is down.
LanguageData.FB_FleshDrainDebugFailed: Could not send a drain raid here.
LanguageData.FB_DevDrainCanisterDesc: Immediately drop one filled canister next to this pump.
LanguageData.FB_DevDrainStepDesc: Run a single hour worth of draining right now.
